content: DeepSeek released Harness v0.1, an open-source, MIT-licensed coding agent framework running locally via browser. Unlike Claude Code's closed system, Harness uses a plugin architecture built on the Cordis microkernel, enabling hot-swappable extensions for models, tools, UI themes, and even sandbox environments. Within 24 hours, the community created 288 plugins, including skins, games, and adapters importing competitors' sessions. The design mirrors Minecraft's moddable foundation—offering a platform rather than a finished product—to eliminate proprietary "harness" premiums and shift competition back to model capabilities and pricing, where DeepSeek holds advantages.

title: DeepSeek今晚的大更新，真的塌房了吗？

DSH serves as configurable "exoskeleton" infrastructure that connects AI models to tools and manages execution. Key features include four work modes—Standard, Minimal, PTC (for efficient task handling via code generation), and Creation mode for custom plugin development. The system's fully modular plugin architecture allows users to modify all functionality, unlike competitors with fixed frameworks. DeepSeek and Peking University published research on "spatiotemporal composability" enabling safe runtime installation/uninstallation of components without restarts. While the V4 Pro model itself drew mixed reactions due to pricing changes and modest capability improvements, the Harness release represents significant infrastructure innovation with potential to democratize AI agent development.

title: DeepSeek Harness 来了，它不想做下一个Codex

Unlike Codex, it emphasizes plugin-driven architecture where models, tools, strategies, storage, context, and UI can all be replaced or combined. title: 深度体验DeepSeek Harness，我原谅它涨价了

Unlike closed alternatives like Codex, DSH enables deep customization of runtime components. The platform aims to become an "Android for agents" through community-driven plugin evolution and potential self-improvement via autonomous plugin development.

title: 红利回撤10%再动手，创业板20%再考虑——年度最大回撤的用法
content: Annual maximum drawdown, reset yearly, offers a practical benchmark for investment timing. For stable assets like dividend indices, waiting for a 10-15% drawdown before buying has historically provided better entry points. For high-beta indices like the ChiNext board, where 20%+ annual drawdowns occur consistently, patience similarly improves risk-adjusted returns. However, this metric cannot guarantee bottoms or prevent consecutive bear-year losses. Its core utility is psychological: discouraging panic chasing at peaks. Markets may not always grant ideal prices—missing some gains outweighs catching severe drawdowns.

title: DeepSeek 昨晚刚开源了 Harness：附万少的2 万字保姆级教程
content:
DeepSeek released its first open-source agent product, DeepSeek Harness (dsh), on August 13 under the MIT license, positioning it as a competitor to Claude Code and Codex. Dsh is an agent runtime framework featuring a graphical web interface, plugin-based architecture requiring Node.js 22+, user-controlled permissions for file operations, and full local execution on the user's machine rather than a closed chat environment.

Setup requires installing Node.js and running `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`. Users must configure API keys for DeepSeek or other providers, select a working project directory, and can then issue tasks. The agent executes real file operations and commands with transparent tool-call tracking, requiring user approval for sensitive actions. Advanced features include model switching, plan mode for complex tasks, sub-agents for parallel work, background tasks, and workflow automation. A headless CLI mode supports scripting and CI pipelines.

title: 夏天做饭像蒸桑拿？一个小东西让灶台降温 20 ℃（爸妈尤其需要 | 原文
content: Summer kitchens without air conditioning can reach 35–40°C when cooking with open flames, creating dangerous conditions especially for elderly people. Prolonged exposure to such heat causes blood vessel dilation, excessive sweating, and body temperature regulation failure. Older adults face higher risks due to reduced heat dissipation capacity and cardiovascular strain, potentially leading to heat stroke. A small device can reduce stovetop temperatures by 20°C, improving kitchen safety.

title: What 50 open source projects taught us about security in the AI era
content: GitHub's Secure Open Source Fund Session 4 invested over $500,000 across 50 open source projects in 22 countries, pairing maintainers with security experts, AI-assisted workflows, and peer communities. Projects like OpenClaw developed incident response plans, audited workflows, and strengthened security processes. AI helped speed vulnerability investigation and response, but maintainers remained essential for context and accountability. The program emphasizes that AI security is becoming integral to broader secure software practices, extending benefits across the entire open source ecosystem.
